SELECT i.unit_id AS unitId, MAX(i.unit_name) AS unitName, MAX(i.campaign_id) AS campaignId, MAX(i.campaign_name) AS campaignName, COUNT(DISTINCT i.stat_date) AS days, ROUND(SUM(i.charge), 2) AS charge, SUM(i.ad_pv) AS adPv, SUM(i.click) AS click, ROUND(SUM(i.click) / NULLIF(SUM(i.ad_pv), 0) * 100, 4) AS ctrPercent, ROUND(SUM(i.charge) / NULLIF(SUM(i.click), 0), 4) AS cpc, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_total), 2) AS gmvTotal, SUM(i.order_total) AS orderTotal, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_total) / NULLIF(SUM(i.charge), 0), 2) AS roi, SUM(i.cart_count) AS cartCount, SUM(i.collect_total) AS collectTotal, MAX(cc.crowd_click) AS crowdClick FROM promo_cost_item_daily i LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.unit_id, SUM(c.click) AS crowd_click FROM promo_cost_item_daily c WHERE c.dimension = 'crowd' AND c.stat_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND c.campaign_id = #{campaignId} GROUP BY c.unit_id) cc ON cc.unit_id = i.unit_id WHERE i.dimension = 'item' AND i.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND i.stat_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY i.unit_id
ORDER BY click IS NULL, click DESC ORDER BY roi IS NULL, roi DESC ORDER BY gmvTotal IS NULL, gmvTotal DESC ORDER BY crowdClick IS NULL, crowdClick DESC ORDER BY charge IS NULL, charge DESC

SELECT i.stat_date AS statDate, ROUND(SUM(i.charge), 2) AS charge, SUM(i.ad_pv) AS adPv, SUM(i.click) AS click, ROUND(SUM(i.click) / NULLIF(SUM(i.ad_pv), 0) * 100, 4) AS ctrPercent, ROUND(SUM(i.charge) / NULLIF(SUM(i.click), 0), 4) AS cpc, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_total), 2) AS gmvTotal, SUM(i.order_total) AS orderTotal, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_total) / NULLIF(SUM(i.charge), 0), 2) AS roi, SUM(i.cart_count) AS cartCount, SUM(i.collect_total) AS collectTotal, MAX(cc.crowd_click) AS crowdClick FROM promo_cost_item_daily i LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.stat_date, SUM(c.click) AS crowd_click FROM promo_cost_item_daily c WHERE c.dimension = 'crowd' AND c.stat_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND c.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND c.unit_id = #{unitId} GROUP BY c.stat_date) cc ON cc.stat_date = i.stat_date WHERE i.dimension = 'item' AND i.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND i.unit_id = #{unitId} AND i.stat_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY i.stat_date ORDER BY i.stat_date

SELECT MAX(i.entity_name) AS keyword, MAX(i.entity_id) AS bidwordId, COUNT(DISTINCT i.stat_date) AS days, ROUND(SUM(i.charge), 2) AS charge, SUM(i.click) AS click, ROUND(SUM(i.charge) / NULLIF(SUM(i.click), 0), 4) AS cpc, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_total), 2) AS gmvTotal, SUM(i.order_total) AS orderTotal, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_total) / NULLIF(SUM(i.charge), 0), 2) AS roi, SUM(i.cart_count) AS cartCount, SUM(i.collect_total) AS collectTotal FROM promo_cost_item_daily i WHERE i.dimension = 'keyword' AND i.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND i.unit_id = #{unitId} AND i.stat_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY i.entity_name
ORDER BY click IS NULL, click DESC ORDER BY roi IS NULL, roi DESC ORDER BY gmvTotal IS NULL, gmvTotal DESC ORDER BY charge IS NULL, charge DESC

SELECT MAX(i.entity_id) AS crowdId, MAX(i.entity_name) AS crowdName, COUNT(DISTINCT i.stat_date) AS days, SUM(i.click) AS click, ROUND(SUM(i.charge), 2) AS charge, (SELECT SUM(x.click) FROM promo_cost_item_daily x WHERE x.dimension = 'item' AND x.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND x.unit_id = #{unitId} AND x.stat_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo}) AS unitClick FROM promo_cost_item_daily i WHERE i.dimension = 'crowd' AND i.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND i.unit_id = #{unitId} AND i.stat_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} GROUP BY i.entity_key ORDER BY click IS NULL, click DESC
